beats.summary: Michael relies on Pam to give him fake phone call notes during meetings to appear busy.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Every time Michael's in a meeting, he makes me come in and give him a Post-It note telling him who's on the phone.
Michael (Pam walks in and shows Michael a note that says "Good Morning"): Yeah, um, tell him I'll call him back.

beats.summary: Michael and Jan discuss Jan's wrongful termination lawsuit and Michael's role in the deposition.

evidence.snippet: Michael: So, here's the deal. Um, I am on my way to New York to be deposed as part of Jan's wrongful termination law suit.
Jan: And they displayed a pattern of disrespect and inappropriate behavior.

beats.summary: Michael tries to memorize Jan's deposition answers and experiences car sickness during the drive.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Could we please pull over and pull down the top, I do not feel good.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I refuse. My house, my rules, I insist.
